text:
04:55 FBN Securities strategist to hold an analyst/industry conference call
Merger-Arbitrage Stragegist Renck, along with Eric Lebson, a former national security official and private sector business intelligence practitioner, will provide an overview of the happenings with the Committee on Foreign Investment in the U.S., (CFIUS), and why it presents both opportunities and challenges to investment fund managers on an Analyst/Industry conference call to be held on July 11 at 11 am.
